top_signals.title: US Targets Iran’s Airlines as New Sanctions Push Continues
top_signals.summary: The US took action against dozens of firms supporting Iran’s aviation sector on Tuesday, as part of a new sanctions effort from the Trump administration that hasn’t appeared to have much impact on Tehran’s main trading partners.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
